description:
Docket Demand MCP connects ChatGPT to your Docket account so you can ask questions about the demand your website AI agents are capturing — in plain English, without opening a dashboard.

Ask about your Website Agents and how they are performing, the visitors and leads they captured, the companies those leads work for, and the conversations they had. Get counts, trends, period-over-period comparisons, and conversation analysis — pain points raised, products visitors asked about, discovery questions, and agreed next steps — plus your agent-attributed meeting bookings.

The connector is strictly read-only. It cannot create, change, or delete anything in Docket. Every request is scoped to your own company's data and to your role's access level, enforced server-side and written to an audit log. Nothing is shared across customers.

You need an existing Docket account whose organization has MCP access enabled. Sign in with your Docket credentials when you connect; ChatGPT sees only the data your Docket role already allows you to see.

defaultPrompt: How many leads did we capture in the last 30 days?
Which website agent booked the most meetings this quarter?
Summarize this week's website conversations: what are the visitors asking about the most?
